findings.title: Unvalidated limit parameter (NaN / unbounded)
findings.description: parseInt of an absent or non-numeric `limit` is NaN, which the query builder treats as no limit, and a huge value is accepted as-is, so the endpoint can return or scan the entire table. Validate it is an integer and clamp, e.g. Math.min(Math.max(n, 1), 100) with a default.
findings.suggestion: Parse with Number.isInteger check, default to 20 and clamp to [1, 100].
